newsitem.title: USA: In Home Health expands hospice services.
newsitem.headline: In Home Health expands hospice services.

text.p: In Home Health Inc said Wednesday that its Minneapolis and Pittsburgh offices received certification to offer hospice services to terminally ill patients under the Medicare program.
The number of markets in which In Home Health has hospice certification has grown from one in 1995 to 12 today.

Obtaining hospice certification under the Medicare program is a key step in becoming a more comprehensive health care provider, In Home Health said in a statement. The company also provides nursing, rehabilitation, infusion therapy and personal care services.
A Medicare Hospice Benefit is available to Medicare-eligible patients considered to be in their last six months of life, and covers virtually all of the costs of a patient's care.
In Home Health provides services through a network of 42 offices in 19 markets located in 13 states.
